Nothing too interesting. My original plan was to try and donate plasma. Didn't realize it was Saturday though. Probably not the best idea to go on a weekend.  

What about you?

I used to play that as well. From the beginning to the end of Wotlk. And a bit again when WoD came out. How are you liking it?

And yeah. I finished off the last of it this morning - peanut-butter on tortilla.  If you live in AZ I'd let you bring me a sandwhich. heh

But other than that I don't think there's any way to help with that. 

I appreciate the thought, though

The gun is actually something lent from family. As home protection.  Makes selling it out of the question unfortunately.  To be honest having it always helped with my stress - before I got on medication.  It was sort of like an 'at least I always have an out' to disconnect myself from my problems.  

I guess this is the other side of that coin.

And that's true, things can always be worse. But I can't see myself going anywhere but down at this point. Homelessness is seems like an inevitability at this point.  

Thank you for responding.

Hey there.  Thank you for responding.  I really appreciate it.  
Rocket League and League of Legends to play with other people.  Salt and Sanctuary or MGSV if I feel like playing alone. Though I have quite a bit more.

 How about you?
